package curriculum

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type PersonalTeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type PlanReason string

const (
	PlanReasonInitial PlanReason = "INITIAL"
	PlanReasonReplan  PlanReason = "REPLAN"
)

type PlanConstraints struct {
	Language       string `json:"language,omitempty"`
	WeeklyMinutes  int    `json:"weekly_minutes,omitempty"`
	PreferredPace  string `json:"preferred_pace,omitempty"`
	Deadline       string `json:"deadline,omitempty"`
	ProjectContext string `json:"project_context,omitempty"`
}

type PlanAuditRefs struct {
	DialogID          string `json:"dialog_id,omitempty"`
	SourceMessageID   string `json:"source_message_id,omitempty"`
	TeacherDecisionID string `json:"teacher_decision_id,omitempty"`
}

type PlanInput struct {
	DiagnosticPlanID string
	StudentID        string
	IdempotencyKey   string
	GoalCode         string
	DesiredOutcome   string
	Targets          []domain.LearningTargetRef
	Constraints      PlanConstraints
	AuditRefs        PlanAuditRefs
	Reason           PlanReason
}

type PlanResult struct {
	RequestID  string `json:"request_id"`
	GoalCode   string `json:"goal_code"`
	Status     string `json:"status"`
	ResultCode string `json:"result_code,omitempty"`
	CourseID   string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Reused     bool   `json:"reused"`
}

type LearningPlanner interface {
	CreateCoursePlan(context.Context, PlanInput) (PlanResult, error)
}

// Planner is a Teacher-owned delegation facade. It recognizes and audits a
// learning request, but all target graph, gap, content, and path decisions are
// delegated to ms-go-learning-planner.
type Planner struct {
	Teachers PersonalTeacherEnsurer
	Overview repository.StudentLearnerOverviewReader
	Plans    LearningPlanner
}

func (planner Planner) Execute(ctx context.Context, input PlanInput) (PlanResult, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.GoalCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalCode))
	input.DesiredOutcome = strings.TrimSpace(input.DesiredOutcome)
	if planner.Teachers == nil || planner.Plans == nil || input.StudentID == "" || input.GoalCode == "" ||
		input.DesiredOutcome == "" || input.Reason == "" {
		return PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.StudentID); err != nil {
		return PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	}
	if _, err := planner.Teachers.Execute(ctx, input.StudentID); err != nil {
		return PlanResult{}, err
	}
	return planner.Plans.CreateCoursePlan(ctx, input)
}

// ExecuteCurrent requests an asynchronous replan after a completed session.
// Student remains the source of the current learner goal and mastery.
func (planner Planner) ExecuteCurrent(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	previousCourseID string,
	triggerID string,
	audit PlanAuditRefs,
) (PlanResult, error) {
	if planner.Overview == nil {
		return PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	}
	overview, err := planner.Overview.GetLearnerOverview(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return PlanResult{}, err
	}
	studentContext, err := domain.NewGeneralStudentContext(overview)
	if err != nil || studentContext.Onboarding == nil {
		return PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return planner.Execute(ctx, PlanInput{
		StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: triggerID,
		GoalCode:       studentContext.Onboarding.GoalCode,
		DesiredOutcome: "Replan after completed learning session",
		Constraints: PlanConstraints{
			Language:       studentContext.Onboarding.PreferredLanguage,
			WeeklyMinutes:  studentContext.Onboarding.WeeklyMinutes,
			PreferredPace:  studentContext.Onboarding.PreferredPace,
			ProjectContext: "continue assigned course " + strings.TrimSpace(previousCourseID),
		},
		AuditRefs: audit, Reason: PlanReasonReplan,
	})
}
